quest.title: Mysterious Islands: Journey to the Unknown
quest.description: Long time no Klee — let's go visit her at the Knights of Favonius headquarters!
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x60, Hero's Wit x3, Mora x30000

chapter.title: Mysterious Islands: Journey to the Unknown

talks.objective: Go to the Knights of Favonius Headquarters

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There she is, over there!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Klee, we haven't seen you in forever!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: #Oh! It's {F#Miss}{M#Mr.} Honorary Knight and Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: *sobs* I was just about to go find you two...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I got a terrible, terrible letter and need to go a certain place!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A terrible letter?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yes, from a person that won't acknowledge that Klee and Dodoco are family. They even said they want to test Klee and have Klee go to Dodoland... But, but...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There's no need to rush, slow down!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Who's this person that you're talking about?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: A very bad, bad, bad guy! He's called Dodo-King!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Who's Dodo-King?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Paimon also hasn't heard of him?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nope. Wait, why did you say "also"?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Because even Klee has never heard of him!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: He's probably just some weirdo!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I went to go find Albedo, but he's not home, so I thought of you!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Let me read you the letter that Dodo-King wrote!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: "Wicked girl of flame, I am of the Dodo Clan"... Uh, Klee can't read this part... "In the name of Dodo-King, you are not qualified to become Dodoco's new family!"

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: "Unless you bring Dodoco to the Golden Apple Archipelago, light four..." Uh... "Accept the..." Um...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I don't know some of these words...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let Paimon have a look!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This word is "overlord," which means he's the most powerful guy around and what he says goes. This part reads, "light four beacons, and knock upon the trialist's gate." Hmm... Probably to accept some kind of challenge.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The last word is "arbitrate," which... which means he wants to judge you.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Arbi... Um... Arbi... trate?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Agh, it's nothing good anyway. He'll judge and criticize you while pretending to be the good guy!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It sounds like he wants you to return Dodoco?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: How could this be!? Dodoco is my bestest friend, so I'll never give Dodoco to him!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: But... He said he's the strongest of the Dodo Clan. Ohh... Could the Dodo Clan be Dodoco's family?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: From the names, it seems like it... But Klee, where is this "Golden Apple Archipelago"?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I don't know.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What!?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: This is also the first time Klee has heard of the "Golden Apple Archipelago." Golden Apple... Archipelago?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: It's probably an island with lots of apples, hehe.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The only things written on the letter were what Klee just read out to us, and there's no signature. Klee, did this letter come with an envelope?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Nope.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Where was this letter sent from?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I don't know. It suddenly appeared on my room's windowsill.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Dodo-King, Dodo Clan... If Paimon remembers correctly, Dodoco is the toy hanging on Klee's backpack, right?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: No! Dodoco is my bestest friend, not some toy!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: O—Oh, right... What a magical creature Dodoco is! But all this sudden talk about family and whatnot is pretty strange... It feels like it might be a prank.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I also suspect it's a prank.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If it's just a prank, then we should ignore it.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: No, no way! I'll never admit defeat! I have to go there!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But we've never even heard of such a place...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: #{F#Miss}{M#Mr.} Honorary Knight, you know what to do, right? Klee believes in you!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Even if we did know what to do...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I'm begging you! Please please help me!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon feels like if we don't agree to help, she'll go off on her own. That'd be dangerous.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Indeed.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Rather than letting Klee go adventuring off by herself, it'd be better if we accompany her!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Ooh, please! Please!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh* How can we say no after seeing you try so hard? But since we're going together, you need to be well-behaved and not run off by yourself!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Okay~!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: As per usual, let's start by asking around for some info.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Cyrus, we want to ask you about a place.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: You'll know it, won't you? Won't you?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Oh? Hahaha... The little adventurer looks troubled. Have you all encountered some sort of problem?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, you could say that. Basically, we want to find a certain archipelago, but it seems no one's ever heard of it. So we came here to ask you, a seasoned adventurer.

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Hahaha, if you seek unknown lands or adventuring knowledge, then you've come to the right man!

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: What kind of archipelago are you all looking for?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: It has lots of small islands on the sea...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's called the Golden Apple Archipelago.

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Golden Apple Archipelago... Er... Hmm... Hm?

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Hahahaha, you're all amazing! You've managed to find a place that even I, the great Cyrus, haven't heard of!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What? Even you don't know of it!?

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Indeed, indeed! The land of Teyvat is immense — no person can walk its entire breadth. But do not fear, dear friends! You must have the courage to venture into the unknown!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Who would've thought that even Cyrus, the Branch Master of the Adventurers' Guild, wouldn't know anything. Could it be that these islands don't exist?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You sure sounded confident a moment ago...

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Ahaha... hahaha... Come now... don't be like that.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: How can this be? Oh, Dodoco...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Marjorie here might have heard about some strange things! After all, souvenirs do come in all shapes and sizes from a variety of places.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Strange things? What do you mean?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you know about the Golden Apple Archipelago? It's made up of lots of small islands and located somewhere in the sea.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Aren't all archipelagos made of small islands and situated at sea?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: That's right!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, uh, right! Ah, then let Paimon ask a different question. Are there archipelagos in Mondstadt?

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Not as far as I know. You've seen a map of Mondstadt, haven't you? All known islands are already charted, so check it out.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Generally speaking, maps will faithfully record the land's topography. For most people, if it's not on a map, it doesn't exist.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mondstadt's map doesn't show any, so that must mean there are none...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A place that doesn't exist? Sounds about right.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: *sobs* How could that be?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: N—N—No, Paimon meant that we should go find other people to ask!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mr. Huffman, do you know about the Golden Apple Archipelago?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: It's on the sea!

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: A Golden Apple Archipelago on the sea? Uh...

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: This is the first I've heard of it. Are they islands that grow many apples?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Aw, so you also don't know...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, given that Huffman's always just patrolling the city...

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: *sigh* I do apologize.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: It's okay, I forgive you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Klee, he wasn't actually apologizing.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Huh, really?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, let's go ask someone else.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Master Jean, I want to ask for some time off because I want to go somewhere!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Klee? Oh, and it's the Honorary Knight and Paimon as well.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: It's been a while, everyone. How have you been?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Barbara's also here! How rare!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did we interrupt a sisterly moment?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Ahem! Oh, o—of course not. Klee, why are you requesting time off all of a sudden?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Klee is going to the Golden Apple Archipelago to meet the Dodo-King or else... or else he'll take Dodoco away!

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Dodo-King? Take Dodoco away?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: *whimper* He doesn't think that Klee is worthy of being part of Dodoco's family...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: #I need to prove myself. {F#Miss}{M#Mr.} Honorary Knight will help me, right?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Traveler, Paimon, is this so?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Klee spoke the truth.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I've never heard of the Golden Apple Archipelago. Where is it?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: I've also never heard of it...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Me either, but Miss Lisa said that someone must know!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: ...So it's a place that even Lisa doesn't know?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes, but I have a hunch.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I see. From what you say, it seems to be quite a mysterious place.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I sincerely apologize, but I cannot approve Knight Klee's request for time off.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Huh? But why? I must go!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Even if these mysterious islands do exist, we cannot determine if they are safe or not. I cannot allow you to journey into a potentially dangerous place.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: If I don't go, Dodoco will be taken away. I—I don't want to lose Dodoco...

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Oh, Klee...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Moreover, how do you intend to reach the islands? Without a safe and reliable plan drawn up, I'm afraid I cannot give you my approval.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Oh... Dodoco...

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Psst! Honorary Knight!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Huh? Is Barbara winking at me?)

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Outside!

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Can you think of a way to get to the islands?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Venti might know a way.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon also thought of him just now! We're on the same wavelength, as expected.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Venti?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, he's a magical bard that Paimon calls "Tone-Deaf Bard."

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Can he help me?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He's our friend, so he'll definitely help!

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: If he's a friend of the Honorary Knight's, then things will work out for sure. We all know how reliable the Honorary Knight is.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: How about this? I'll try to persuade Master Jean. You all know she's a serious person, so I think it might take some time...

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Klee, trust me, okay? I'll do everything I can to help you.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Okay, I can wait.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Wonderful! Tomorrow afternoon, let's all meet at <color=#00E1FFFF>the plaza outside the Cathedral</color>. I'm sure I'll have some good news, just leave it to me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're so dependable! Do your best, Barbara!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're all here now!

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Everyone, over here.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: #{F#Miss}{M#Mr.} Honorary Knight, Paimon~

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Greetings.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh, Master Jean is also here.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Yes, it's a long story...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Barbara and Lisa have both spoken to me, and there is something that I have realized. Regardless if I approve it or not, Klee will go where she wants to anyway. This is how it has always been.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Ehehe...

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: We all know Klee. Rather than have her run headlong into danger, it's better to agree to her request.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Knight Klee, your request for leave has been approved.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Wow! I'm so excited!

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: However, there are conditions!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: In exchange, I will be accompanying everyone to this letter's Golden Apple Archipelago. As for the Knights' affairs, I have entrusted them to Kaeya.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Work has been busy and I shouldn't leave, but... I wouldn't be able to stop worrying about Klee.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: So, please allow me to travel with you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright! There won't be any problems if Master Jean comes with us!

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Big Sis— I mean, Master Jean also suggested that I come along. Barbatos forbid, but I can assist if someone needs medical treatment during our journey.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're so lucky to have Barbara too!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Miss Barbara, Master Jean, you two are so nice. I promise I'll behave!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Klee, you always say that. I hope you will abide by your words this time.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Lisa heard that I wanted to accompany everyone to the islands, so she prepared this pouch. Supposedly, opening it will reveal a new way.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: New way? You mean a way to keep Klee out of trouble?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: She said not to open it until we've reached the islands. I think it might be something to use in case of an emergency.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: As expected of Miss Lisa! She's been thinking of us this whole time.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Anyway, our next step is to find the bard, right? I just asked the people nearby. They said that he hasn't performed at the square today and that he likely went to Windrise.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What are we waiting for? Let's head to <color=#00E1FFFF>Windrise</color> and find Tone-Deaf Bard.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like the people of Mondstadt don't know anything about the place in this letter.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Feels more and more like a prank to me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Klee, is there anyone you can think of that you don't get along with? Would there be anyone who'd write a letter to scare you?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: No, I love everyone very much, and everyone loves Klee very much.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mm, Paimon thinks so, too.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: So it can't be a prank!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, it's not a prank, yet no one knows where these islands are. Ugh, this is getting more and more confusing.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Is there someone even more knowledgeable we could ask?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Knowledgeable... Right!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We should ask Lisa about this kind of thing! She's at the library every day and has probably read every book in Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Oh! Miss Lisa!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's go to the <color=#00E1FFFF>library</color>!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Venti! We found you!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hm? If so many people are looking for me, then I suppose it is something important?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Venti, do you know of the Golden Apple Archipelago?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is the map of the islands.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Oh, yes, that place... Hahaha, congratulations, you've found the right person.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Wowowooow, you really do know!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: So now they're called the Golden Apple Archipelago, huh? They used to be known as the Haar Islands. They're located on a stretch of sea that's particularly difficult for the average person to reach.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Not to mention, the area has strong storms and thick fog year-round. Ships can hardly approach the islands, let alone dock.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Why do you guys wish to go there?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: I'm going there to meet Dodo-King! He said he wants to test Klee to see if she's qualified to be Dodoco's family!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hmm. Are you nervous?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: A little... But I will not give in. Master Tone-Deaf Bard, you must help us!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Master Tone-Deaf Bard... Interesting. I like it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Paimon, you're a bad influence...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is this Paimon's fault?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Fear not! Since you wish it so, Master Tone-Deaf Bard will lend a helping hand.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Could you really help us?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Of course! In this world, what is more pure and free than the wish of a child?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: What a beautiful sound...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Is the wind picking up?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Wait just a moment, he'll be here soon.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Th—That's...!?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Uh—uhh...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: This is a secret between us here, so don't tell anyone else.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: One of the Four Winds!?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Oh! My dear poet, you have my utmost gratitude for the aid you have provided us.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: The Acting Grand Master sure is formal.

choices.text: We knew you'd have a way, Venti.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Haha, what wonderful expressions you all have!

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: I'll see you off here. May the winds bless your travels~!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Lisa!

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Oh, well if it isn't cutie, Paimon, and Klee. What brings you to the library all of a sudden?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There's something we want to ask you.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Miss Lisa, can you help Klee find an arki—archipelago?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: An archipelago?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Dodo-King told Klee to go to the Golden Apple Archipelago so he can challenge Klee!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Klee, let Paimon explain. Lisa, it's like this...

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Let me get this straight. To determine if Klee is worthy of becoming Dodoco's family, the ruler of the Dodo Clan, Dodo-King, wrote a letter to Klee summoning her to this Golden Apple Archipelago to be judged?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Does that sum it up?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Yes! I have to go!

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: And you cuties sought me out to help Klee find the location of this Golden Apple Archipelago, correct?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's right. You're one of the smartest people in Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Haha, how sweet of you to say. Then I have no choice but to assist you in earnest.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Klee, can you show me that letter?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Okay!

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Hmm. Though there's little information written upon the letter, have you all tried any other methods?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Other methods?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: The letter contains faint elemental traces that seem more like a hint than anything else. Maybe try using your Elemental Sight.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Right, why didn't we think of that! Let's take a look!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did you find anything?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Something appeared on the back of the letter.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Most of the content on the reverse page was applied via elemental power. What an interesting approach.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Here's a pen. Cutie, can I trouble you to copy down what you see with your Elemental Sight?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Done!

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: The information on the reverse page is now clear. This drawing is likely of the Golden Apple Archipelago you've been looking for.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A ton of small islands floating by themselves in the water without being anchored to any land... It's almost like they popped up from the seabed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Like they appeared out of thin air!

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Hmm. Paimon, you might be right.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: I don't understand what you mean...

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: I've read every single book within this library's walls. Similar islands have been mentioned in some of them.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: A mysterious archipelago enveloped by storms and dense fog, belonging to no nation. That which is outside cannot enter, nor can anything inside leave. Only those who are chosen may enter its territory.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Many years ago, a fleet from Mondstadt encountered some islands at sea. Reportedly, there were torrential rains and howling winds. The sailors could hardly discern land through the thick fog.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: The islands weren't far, but no matter how much they sailed, they never grew closer. The sailors were initially confused but then became terrified, as they believed they were hallucinating.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Woah, talk about mysterious and creepy...

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, the books do not record the location of these islands. I'm afraid that if you want more information, you'll have to find someone more knowledgeable than I.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And Paimon thought Lisa would be the expert on this kind of thing.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: I am but a librarian who prefers to stay inside with her books.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Klee, do you really want to go to those islands? It might be a very scary place.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Yes, I want to go!

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Haha, my, how brave. Far be it from me to scare a child, but Klee, you really should take someone with you, just in case. Someone reliable, like my cutie over here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Klee, you're not scared?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: I'm scared, but not being able to be Dodoco's family is even scarier...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Dodoco is very important to me... I won't lose to Dodo-King!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: I'll need to ask for some time off so I can go to the Golden Apple Archipelago and find Dodo-King.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Time off?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: That's right, I'm a Knight of Favonius. Master Jean told me that if Klee wants to go someplace far, then she has to ask for time off.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're going to ask for time off... now? We still don't even know where these islands are!

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Cutie, judging by the look on your face, you have an idea, don't you?

choices.text: I have some impressive friends in Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: It'll be up to you to get Jean's approval. I'll stay here and silently cheer for you all while enjoying a book and some tea.

talks.objective: Wait until the next day and go to the square (12:00 – 18:00)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...A boat?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: It looks as if someone has been awaiting our arrival.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are we really supposed to sail in such terrible weather?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I'm afraid that appears to be the intention. Everyone... Everything about these islands is a mystery. Regardless of what lies ahead, please proceed with utmost caution.

talks.objective: Talk to everyone about the island

dialogues.speaker: Dvalin
dialogues.text: This is as far as I go.

dialogues.speaker: Dvalin
dialogues.text: It would be cumbersome for me to proceed further. Please exercise caution.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: We're here, we finally made it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Tone-Deaf Bard sure knows when to pull out all the stops, suddenly letting us ride over on a dragon! Paimon almost got blown away...

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Th—That was my first time riding on a dragon's back. M—My heart won't stop pounding...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Phew... Is everyone alright?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Yes, I'm fine. Big Sis— uh Master Jean, just who is that bard?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Well, uh...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: He's a legendary bard of exceptional musical talent who can use his lyre to call forth all manner of creatures.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, even Master Jean is pretty quick on the spot...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A necessary skill for managing subordinates.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Wow, what an impressive person. We must properly thank him when we return.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Agreed. In any case, what are these islands?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: The weather is dreadful, the fog is thick, and visibility is low. Just like Lisa said.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We should be extra careful.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Traveler, Paimon, what else does the letter say?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Paimon remembers! It read, "Wicked girl of flame, I am of the Dodo Clan as its overlord. In the name of Dodo-King, you are not qualified to become Dodoco's new family!"

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Unless...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Unless you bring Dodoco to the Golden Apple Archipelago, light the four beacons, and knock upon the trialist's gate to accept your challenge."

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Four beacons? Does that mean he wants us to find something that emits light?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now that you mention it, doesn't it seem like it's a little less foggy here than the surrounding area?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Looking carefully, that indeed appears to be the case.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Could the clearing of the fog be related to this device?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Don't you think it looks familiar, {NICKNAME}? Pretty similar to the Portable Waypoints we've used before.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Crafting Portable Waypoints requires Luminescent Spines, so they can also function as a source of light. So if this device here seems like it can dissipate fog, maybe it's a similar kind of device.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I think so, too.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: "Light four beacons, and knock upon the trialist's gate"... What will happen after we light up all four beacons?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: There's already one lit device here. It appears that we need to find the other three and light them up as well.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Huh? What's that?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hey, don't run off... Agh, c'mon, {NICKNAME}, catch up to her!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: It looks like something's <color=#00E1FFFF>down there</color>!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Let's take a closer look.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: The fog's gone!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, it's actually pretty scenic here.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: The four beacons have been lit, but we still don't know what trials may lie ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Ahh, the weather's so nice!

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: I know we can't afford to drop our guard, but I can't help but enjoy the summer...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: I wanna catch fish!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Klee, this isn't Mondstadt. Please be careful.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Oh. I understand...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Paimon, after we deal with Dodo-King together, we can go catch some fish!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, sure, whatever you say!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Who or what exactly is Dodo-King?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You seem concerned.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Yes. It is also my first time here. This may not sound fair to Klee, but my primary duty is to protect everyone. Finding this overlord is secondary.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Also, the sudden appearance of this letter, these islands that are inaccessible by ordinary people... It's too much of a coincidence. Why would this sort of invitation be sent to a child?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: It's truly unbelievable... I also mustn't be careless.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, what are we all waiting for? Let's start exploring the area!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Carefree and ready to explore, classic Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Paimon's right. We should take advantage of the clear weather to reassess our situation.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Even on a mysterious island, I have no worries as long as you're here.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Whew! So, should we go swimming first?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: *sigh* Barbara is always happy-go-lucky when she sees such beautiful scenery.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Traveler, please feel free to explore. I'll be at the ready if there is any sign of danger.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I hope this island doesn't give us too much trouble...

talks.objective: Find and light up all the devices
Find and light up all the devices
Find and light up all the devices
Go to high ground to ascertain the situation

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Come to think of it, {NICKNAME}, we haven't seen Klee for a while, have we?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's go find her! She'll probably be happy to see us, too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But where would she be at this time of day?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We might as well check with the <color=#00E1FFFF>Knights</color>!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's walk around the city and ask people who might know something about the situation.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's time! Let's meet up with Barbara and Klee at the plaza!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The surrounding fog seems to have lifted! Lighting these devices is really useful.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The surrounding area is gradually becoming clearer. Let's go and find the last one!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've found all the devices! Let's go <color=#00E1FFFF>someplace higher up</color> to get a view of our surroundings.
